identity_boundary: Relational working label only; no consciousness, personhood, identity continuity, qualification, agency, or authority claim.

methods.title: homography-action
methods.failure_signature: Wrong exact response, invalid admission, mutated request, missing conflict, or protected-claim promotion.
methods.candidate_workaround: Retain the failed subject and rebuild only a separate corrected copy.
methods.recurrence_guard: Compare exact envelopes, request digests, dispositions and protected gates.
methods.rollback: Remove only the uncommitted X2 delta and return to immutable X1.
methods.scope_boundary: Finite exact rational owner-local evidence only.
